english.title: Use / keep a motor vehicle - fail to comply with off-road notification
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[kept]_

a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), having made a declaration or statement under the Road Vehicles (Statutory Off-Road Notification) Regulations 1997 that the vehicle would not during the period specified in the declaration or statement be used on a public road
english.legislation: Contrary to section 29(1) and (3A) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use/keep a mechanically propelled vehicle on a public road
having made a declaration/statement that the vehicle
would not be used on road during the period specified

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Regulation 2 of the Road Vehicles (Statutory Off- Road Notification) Regulations 1997 for definitions.
(ii) See Regulation 4 of the Road Vehicles (Statutory Off- Road Notification) Regulations 1997 for exemptions.
(iii) See Regulation 5 of the Road Vehicles (Statutory Off- Road Notification) Regulations 1997 re surrender of vehicle licence, Regulation 6 re vehicle licence not renewed and Regulation 7 re person keeping an unlicensed vehicle.
(iv) In proceedings under this section the burden of proof lies with the defendant with regard to the using or keeping of a vehicle without a licence (Section 53 Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994).
(v) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(vi) See offence wording H812 for the additional offence of keeping mechanically propelled vehicle on public road.

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.
or
An amount of excise duty equal to the annual rate of duty applicable to the vehicle at the date on which the offence was committed.

NOTE:
Where, in the case of a vehicle KEPT (BUT NOT USED) on a public road that annual rate differs from the annual rate by reference to which the vehicle was at that date chargeable under Section 2(2) to (4) ie. the annual rate currently applicable, the amount of excise duty chargeable is to be taken for those purposes to be an amount equal to the latter rate.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
